text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm taking a walk through the park one day when the sound of a familiar voice brings me to a stop.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeeesss! Thank heavens! Could you come over here, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Boy, am I glad that you happened by.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The thing is, I need you to be the usher in this wedding that's about to start.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Is this the usher? Great! Then, let's hurry and start!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look in the direction of the voice to find a boy and girl around preschool age sitting happily on a picnic sheet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So basically… these kids are having a pretend wedding and I got roped into playing the officiant.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But they started raising a fuss about there being no usher. So… hehe… would you mind helping out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to take on the role of usher to assist a troubled Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Now then, bride and groom. Do you both vow to love each other in sickness and in health?

text_block_list.name: Bride & Groom
text_block_list.text: I do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well said! Then, I now pronounce you husband and wife!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Let's see, what comes next again? Uhhh… Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I'll just make up some vows of my own.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Anytime, anywhere, in sickness and in health, I vow to make you vow every vow ever vowed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And you, usher, do you vow to make our bride and groom feel comfortable anytime and anywhere, no matter what?

text_block_list.name: Groom
text_block_list.text: Um… excuse me. Doesn't this wedding have too many vows?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what are you saying?! This ceremony is being run perfectly by-the-book! Now, next is… Um…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite carefully faking her way through the wedding thus far, Matikanetannhauser finally starts to stumble. That's when…

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Wait just a minute! Just what do you think you're doing getting married?!

text_block_list.name: Groom
text_block_list.text: Agh! W-wait, it's not what it looks like! We're just playing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ummm… What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Just playing, huh? So this is all just a game to you? Including me? I bet it made you feel like a big boy, toying with a maiden's heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't quite grasp the situation—nor do I want to—but if I didn't know better, I'd say this is a lovers' quarrel!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun-mun… We can't let a fight break out! As the grown-ups here, we have to put a stop to this! Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey! HEY! Everyone, listen up! You all know who this is, right?

text_block_list.name: Bride
text_block_list.text: Isn't that the usher?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Exactly! Ushers are here to escort us all to where we belong! You must never let them see you fighting, or they'll escort you right outside!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about?! We're already outside!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: New plan! Quick, Trainer! Fire your Usher Beam!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There. Now you've all become the best of friends. I want the three of you to play together nicely now, you hear?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser uses her quick wits—or something like that—to put a stop to the fight before things get out of hand.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: As officiant, I've vowed to make everyone else swear vows.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Then, by the power invested in me as officiant, I lay down my benevolent decree.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All of you need to deepen your understanding of love so you don't get into any more fights.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Which meeeeans… it's time for Officiant Machitan's Love Seminar!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So, let's see here… lesson one! Don't go around telling just anybody that you love them! Also…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although it seems more like a seminar in common sense than love, Matikanetannhauser successfully delivers a sermon on morality.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! I've always been good with children. Whenever my little brother got into fights with his friends, I was the one who had to break things up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Now, we could continue the ceremony… but things will probably just get messy again, so let's play something else!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: How about tag? Red Light, Green Light? Just promise that you'll all play nice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The children appear to have settled their differences, so all five of us play together happily for a while.
